main_measure.name: clustered-by-day LS slope of coin excess 3-bar return on post_pipeline_value
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 and mean short-direction unusual move > 0; reject if slope t <= -2

decided_by: The slope t lies between -2 and 2. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction -0.441 (below 1), 1016 cases (30 needed).
reading: Grid bars are positions 0,3,6,... of each window with a full 3-bar return inside the window; the coin's mean 3-bar return (the drift) is taken over all its grid bars in all windows; the slope t uses a day-clustered (UTC date) sandwich standard error with a G/(G-1) correction; the profile is read from the recorded regime and the depth from last_history_value.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction -0.441 (below 1), 1016 cases (30 needed)
